title: Aurélie — Privacy Policy
html:
Legal

Privacy policy.

Last updated · 1 July 2026

01 · Who we are

Aurélie Fine Jewellery Private Limited ("Aurélie", "we", "us") operates this website and the Aurélie atelier at Civil Lines, Jaipur. This policy explains how we handle personal information in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and other applicable Indian law.

02 · What we collect

  • Details you give us — name, email, phone, addresses, ring or bangle size, and preferences you share when ordering or booking a viewing.
  • Order information — items purchased, delivery details and service history (for your lifetime-service entitlement).
  • Payment information — processed entirely by RBI-licensed gateways. We never store card numbers, UPI PINs or banking credentials.
  • Usage information — pages viewed, wishlist activity and device data, via the cookies described below.

03 · How we use it

To fulfil and deliver your orders, provide lifetime polishing and resizing against your purchase history, respond to enquiries, arrange viewings you request, and meet legal obligations such as BIS hallmarking records and tax law. The Aurélie Letter is sent only if you subscribe — unsubscribe anytime.

04 · What we never do

We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information. It is shared only with delivery and insurance partners (to ship your order), payment gateways (to process payment), and authorities where the law requires.

05 · Cookies

Essential cookies keep your bag and wishlist working; limited analytics cookies help us understand how the site is used. You can disable non-essential cookies in your browser without affecting your ability to order.

06 · Keeping your data safe

All traffic is encrypted in transit. Order records live on servers in India with access restricted to trained atelier staff, and high-value delivery details are shared with couriers per shipment only.

07 · Your rights

Request a copy of your data, ask for corrections, or ask for deletion (subject to legal retention of invoices and hallmark records) by writing to care@aurelie.com. We respond within 7 working days.

08 · Grievance officer

Grievance Officer, Aurélie Fine Jewellery Pvt. Ltd., Civil Lines, Jaipur 302006 · care@aurelie.com · +91 141 000 0000. This policy may be updated from time to time; the date above always reflects the current version.
